sentences.en: Do you know anyone who hums while they work?
sentences.zh: 你知道有人边工作边哼歌吗？

sentences.en: A melody is not merely something you can hum.
sentences.zh: 旋律不仅仅是你能哼唱的东西。

sentences.en: It hums in my ears from the yell of young children.
sentences.zh: 孩子们的喊声在我耳边嗡嗡作响。

mnemonic: 发音记忆：“哼”→蚊子苍蝇的哼哼声
